bayts.text: Praise be to Allah, Who changes the evil deed into a good deed (Qurʾān 25:70) and gives abundantly,
and His blessings upon him from whom all that he brought was accepted, and who was preferred.
That said: truly today I turn in repentance to a Forgiving Lord, hoping for acceptance,
seeking intercession by His grace and by the standing of His Beloved, al-Māḥī, mighty in standing.
O our Lord, truly I repent today: spare me, in this world and the Next, from blame.
O our Lord, truly I confess the sins: so forgive me the sins and efface the faults.
O our Lord, through the Elect accept all the deeds I have put forward.
O our Lord, by the right of "In the Name of Allah", grant me a protection without end.
O our Lord, through the Chosen, the Family and the Companions, answer my request.
And bless and grant peace upon the Prophet and his Family, and bestow on me good manners.
And bless and grant peace upon the Messenger and his Family, and grant me through him arrival (at the goal).
And bless and grant peace upon the Most Pious and his Family, and grant me through him victory.
And bless and grant peace upon the Bearer of glad tidings and his Family, and be for me, through him, a Helper.
And bless and grant peace upon the Warner and his Family, and be for me, through him, Forgiving.
And bless and grant peace upon the Obeyed and his Family, and grant me through him following (him).
And bless and grant peace upon the Noble and his Family, and grant me through him the sciences.
And bless and grant peace upon the Guidance (al-Hudā) and his Family, and grant me through him right guidance.
And bless and grant peace upon the Guidance and his Family, and through him let right guidance suffice me.
And bless and grant peace upon the Guidance and his Family, and grant me through him following his example.
And bless and grant peace upon him and his Family, and whoever is traced back to him.
And bless him, then grant peace, and his Family and his Companions, and magnify (them).
And provide me today, by his immense standing, the abandoning of innovation, which might draw the painful (punishment) upon me.
And bless him, then grant peace, and his Family and his Companions, and honour (them).
And provide me today, through him, deliverance from enemies, and through me provide for the needy.
And bless him, then grant peace, and the Family, the Companions and whoever is linked to him.
And provide me today, through him, tranquillity, and let me see the Kaʿba and Medina.
And bless and grant peace upon him, his Family and his Companions with him.
And provide me today, through him, steadfastness in You and in him, Lord, and growth.
And bless and grant peace upon him and his Family, and whoever has hastened to him.
And provide me today, through him, rightness in all I do, and the reward.
